details: 27 November 2023 board of trustees report confirms the 151-foot stupa and the all-round renovations and gold-leaf work completed in April 2023.
The Yangon Region committee describes the octagonal composition through the tapering bud and the four cardinal shrines.
Daytime field visit documents the four worship halls on the platform, the octagonal terraces and plane of the spire.
Stadtner, Sacred Sites of Burma, pp. 106–111. Four halls on raised platform, south and east approached from their axis, surviving renovations and historic prospect.
